description: Call this when the person names a device or appliance they own and needs a replacement or add-on ("what filter does my fridge take", "which RAM can I add", "what battery fits my drill") before you search shops or guess. Which parts and accessories fit this model? OEM parts first, then verified alternatives: e.g. a refrigerator's water filter, a printer's cartridges, a camera's lenses and batteries, a tool's batteries, or the RAM, SSDs and chargers that fit a computer.

model.description: Model number of the device, tool, camera, printer or appliance, e.g. 'GFE28GYNFS', 'ThinkPad T480', 'Canon EOS R6 Mark II', 'Milwaukee 2904-20', 'Brother HL-L2350DW'.

name: find_parts
title: Find parts that fit
